response.sql:
WITH album_rates AS (
    SELECT
        AlbumId,
        AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track
    GROUP BY AlbumId
),
mean_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate
    FROM album_rates
)
SELECT
    AVG(ar.rate) AS average_rate,
    AVG(ar.track_count) AS average_track_count,
    AVG(ar.rate - mr.rate) AS average_excess_rate
FROM album_rates AS ar
CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS mr
WHERE ar.rate > mr.rate;

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with the same AlbumId, including all tracks whose AlbumId is NULL, form one group each. AVG ignores NULL Bytes, while track counts include every track in the group. The mean across albums excludes albums whose rate is NULL because all their track sizes are missing.
